{{Quote|Disa one of Colonel Zarvold's men. Raxa Binn, shesa hatin' Zarvold&mdash;mesa not knowin' why&mdash;an' will like dis detanator for, mesa thinkin', sentimental value.|Booto Lubble, to a spacer|<ref name="AED" /> }}
'''Zarvold''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The colonel commanded an [[Colonel Zarvold's Imperial Army battalion|Imperial Army battalion]] stationed on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], where Zarvold's forces regularly patrolled the wilderness in opposition to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] presence at [[Zephyr Base]].

==Biography==
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="AED" /> around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] Zarvold oversaw an [[Colonel Zarvold's Imperial Army battalion|Imperial Army battalion]] operating on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Zarvold's [[Sexes/Legends|men]] carried standard-issue equipment,<ref name="AED" /> including [[Code cylinder/Legends|rank cylinders]]<ref name="Cylinder">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Officer Jinnor's Rank Cylinder}}</ref> and [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[Class-A thermal detonator/Legends|Class-A explosive devices]].<ref name="Detonator">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Imperial Army Thermal Detonator}}</ref>

[[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] and various [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial troopers]] of Zarvold's [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] came into conflict with operatives of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] working out of [[Zephyr Base]], particularly through the actions of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] liaison [[Booto Lubble]].<ref name="AED" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
In an attempt to court<ref name="AED" /> the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]]<ref name="Binn">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Raxa Binn|Rori}}</ref> [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Teacher/Legends|trainer]] [[Raxa Binn]], Lubble directed a Rebel [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] members of Zarvold’s command. Among the targets were [[Warrant Officer/Legends|Warrant Officer]] [[Luhin Jinnor]], who carried a rank cylinder, and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rohd Gostervek]], who possessed a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]]. Both were slain by Rebel-aligned operative, who returned the equipment to Lubble for use in a [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]] intended as a gift to Binn.<ref name="AED" />
{{Endgame}}
==Personality and traits==
According to Lubble, Raxa Binn harbored a strong hatred for Zarvold, though the reasons were not clear to him.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Colonel Zarvold was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Zarvold did not appear as a direct non-player character, but was referenced through quest dialogue<ref name="AED" /> and quest item descriptions<ref name="Cylinder" /><ref name="Detonator" /> tied to Booto Lubble at Zephyr Base on Rori. Zarvold's subordinates, including Warrant Officer Luhin Jinnor and Captain Rohd Gostervek, appeared as quest targets for Rebel-aligned players.<ref name="AED" />
